units.roll: Blender edit-bone roll radians and degrees

selection_rule: Independent native terminal v284 mapped by full topology identity plus existing surface-endpoint/30-percent helper convention; IP head separately revalidated. No nearest-to-current candidate optimization.

THUMB_IP_R.head.evidence_basis: Independent RSSF axial/IP section and true loops; current point is central within method resolution, 16/16 radial containment and 6.220 mm clearance. Exact centroid equality is NOT claimed.

THUMB_IP_R.tail.evidence_basis: Mapped native terminal tip v284 in approved RSSF, compatible with explicit fingertip surface-landmark contract; cap37 corroborates membership only.

THUMB_IP_R.roll.evidence_basis: Projected approved thumb nail normal onto independently corrected distal axis; right-handed orthonormal XYZ. Recomputed roll, no flip.

THUMB_TIP_R.head.evidence_basis: Mapped native terminal tip v284 in approved RSSF, compatible with explicit fingertip surface-landmark contract; cap37 corroborates membership only.

THUMB_TIP_R.tail.evidence_basis: Existing helper tail convention: mapped terminal + 0.30*(mapped terminal - independently revalidated IP head).

THUMB_TIP_R.roll.evidence_basis: Projected approved thumb nail normal onto independently corrected distal axis; right-handed orthonormal XYZ. Recomputed roll, no flip.
